title: Tuesday, 6:31 a.m.
intro: A bedroom you have never seen. It knows you.

items.label: Red ribbon on the doorknob
items.text: A bit of red ribbon, tied in a neat bow. Not Mags's style. Somebody was here before you woke up.

items.label: Mirror
items.text: A tired, kind face. Fingertips pruned like you've been in the bath for hours. They don't smooth out.

items.label: Bicuspid (cat)
items.text: The orange cat looks up, then bows his head all the way to the floor. Then he leads you to an empty bowl, as if you owe him breakfast.

items.label: Cat bowl
items.text: BICUSPID, in marker. 'Feed 7:15 sharp.' It is 6:32. You have time to be a good person.

items.label: Locked bottom drawer
items.text: The key is taped under the drawer. Inside: eleven names on a list, each with a tick, and a box of yellow X-ray envelopes marked PELL, C.

items.label: Bible on the nightstand
items.text: Tucked in the pages: a one-way ticket on the 6:40 launch. Not for today. For Wednesday.

items.label: Appointment book
items.text: Eight patients, nine o'clock to four. The handwriting is Mags's, nearly. The ink is a different pen, and the loops lean the other way.

items.label: Phone
items.text: One unplayed voicemail from Priya: 'Don't go before Thursday. Please. I think I found the pattern.'

items.label: Framed photograph
items.text: An old man in a dentist's chair. 'C. Pell, 1958.' The window behind him is exactly the window in your office.

items.label: Fridge note
items.text: THU - INDEX? with a little tooth sticker. Below it, a magnet: POP. 913.

items.label: Half-packed suitcase
items.text: Seven pairs of socks and one very serious toothbrush. Someone was leaving and trying not to look like it.

items.label: Sad houseplant
items.text: A fern with the energy of a Monday. You water it. It does not say thank you but you feel seen.
